scope: Tree tuning and temporal validation review for the second autonomous run. Research/config preparation only; root owns sequential training.

current_winner.recipe: Frozen plant-specific Transformer fractions; remaining probability weight split equally between rescaled XGBoost and LightGBM.

facts_from_source_review: src/train_xgboost.py and src/train_baseline.py split complete cases chronologically and require last training end <= first validation start.
Both trainers exclude all prediction_mapping Run No values from fitting and validation labels.
Feature and label ordering is generator -> case -> hour; rescale_tree_features reshapes each contiguous168-hour case and does not use labels or cross-case fitted statistics.

The baseline active economic columns are monetary prices, price differences, and terminal water values. All are rescaled together by max(mean(abs(provided168-hourprices)),10), with log scale retained.
XGBoost native categorical generator identity has a fixed category set across training and validation; LightGBM marks generator_id categorical.
Pooled flattened binary AUC is the same ranking target as the provided micro ROC-AUC. Generator-specific AUC is diagnostic, not a substitute selection metric.
Rescaled XGBoost2021 best1451 with cap1500 did not allow the full100-round patience after the best score; convergence remains unverified.
LightGBM2021 best1499/cap1500 and2022 best800/cap800 are truncated fits. Establish convergence before interpreting other hyperparameter changes.
Earlier unscaled regularization/sampling results have conflicting year effects. They do not establish the best settings after the large rescaling change.

pitfalls.finding: The old comparison helper uses the pre-LightGBM blend as baseline. Its candidate_equal_tree_mean can silently drop the current LightGBM when testing a new XGBoost.
pitfalls.action: Use a comparison anchored to current winner config, replacing only the component under test and preserving frozen plant weights. Root confirmed implementing src/round2_compare.py.

pitfalls.finding: The same validation labels select early-stopping iteration and report that iteration score. Hyperparameter selection and repeated year reuse add optimism.
pitfalls.action: Call these development results. Freeze candidate architecture/parameters before2022. Prefer fixed2021-selected tree count for the2022 confirmation, or an earlier chronological inner stop set; if native early stopping is retained, report that limitation.

pitfalls.finding: Warm-start LightGBM n_estimators is additional rounds, not a total cap.
pitfalls.action: Record initial, additional, and total tree counts. Do not compare800old trees to800additional trees as if equal budgets.

pitfalls.finding: Overlapping case-hours are not independent observations; ordinary random-row CV or row-wise bootstrap yields misleading precision.
pitfalls.action: Keep all2352 outputs per case together. Temporal training/validation splits purge six overlapping starts. For uncertainty, use paired multiweek blocks, retain all generators/hours, and label uncertainty approximate under seasonal drift.

pitfalls.finding: XGBoost min_child_weight is Hessian mass, not a minimum sample count. LightGBM min_child_samples is a different quantity.
pitfalls.action: Do not numerically equate their regularization strengths.

pitfalls.finding: LightGBM subsample alone has no effect with default subsample_freq0.
pitfalls.action: A future LGB sampling candidate must specify subsample_freq>0 and subsample<1.

screen_protocol: Use all existing training cases, exactly the same feature flags113columns, case ordering, random_state42, four threads, patience100, and2200-tree caps in all six2021 screens. Only named settings differ. Avoid random-row training reduction.
Budget permits at most these six configurations; stop launching candidates if it threatens cross-year checks or final model/export time.
Score standalone AUC and substitution into the actual current ensemble with identical frozen weights. Primary promotion criterion is ensemble improvement, not standalone accuracy alone.
After2021screen, freeze at most two candidates for2022. Record every rejection. Rank by consistency across years and months, not maximum of any available score.
Do not search plant blend weights simultaneously with tree settings. A candidate helping only one year is inconclusive; a smaller benefit in both can be more useful.

For an additional2020check, train original rescaled baseline plus the selected candidate using <=2019-12-25 starts, score all2020case starts. Existingconfigs/goal_xgboost_rescaled_2020.json is ready. Prior2020price/hydraulic/recency reports mean this is an additional temporal check, not pristine validation.
Compare2020tree models directly unless all needed2020neural/LGB OOF components exist. Never apply a2021/2022-trained model to2020 and call that held-out performance.

Repeated2021/2022development and public leaderboard feedback already influenced formulation. No statistical procedure can retroactively make these untouched; report local results as development evidence.

candidate_configs.name: longer
candidate_configs.hypothesis: Check whether the prior 1500-tree cap truncated early stopping; all substantive settings unchanged.

candidate_configs.name: depth4
candidate_configs.hypothesis: Test lower interaction capacity after economic rescaling; depth6 may overfit correlated case-hours.

candidate_configs.name: depth8
candidate_configs.hypothesis: Test whether depth6 restricts reservoir/generator interactions; increased capacity may improve fit or widen generalization gap.

candidate_configs.name: child100
candidate_configs.hypothesis: Require more Hessian mass per leaf; isolate leaf support regularization from depth and L2.

candidate_configs.name: lambda10
candidate_configs.hypothesis: Shrink leaf scores with stronger L2; isolate leaf-weight regularization from depth and minimum child Hessian.

candidate_configs.name: sampling
candidate_configs.hypothesis: Test stochastic boosting using mild row and column sampling; this is row sampling within training, not grouped validation.

deferred_alternatives.idea: Lower tree learning rate .025 with approximately doubled iteration budget
deferred_alternatives.why_deferred: Neural optimization lane already tests lower learning rate; six bounded tree screens isolate capacity/regularization first.

deferred_alternatives.idea: XGBoost gradient-based sampling with hist on CPU
deferred_alternatives.why_relevant: Official stable docs report CPU support since3.2; installed3.4.1 can emphasize high-gradient observations without old GPU-only restriction. Would require a separate controlled subsample comparison.
Different inductive bias and a documented way to regularize/speed splits; feasible future alternative after convergence.
Provides cleaner evaluation of selection procedure but adds fits and must retain the six-day case purge at each boundary.

deferred_alternatives.idea: Block bagging or selecting different weekly start phases
deferred_alternatives.why_relevant: Controls dependence among heavily overlapping weekly cases and offers diversity; any changed subset must be compared on the same validation cases and not mistaken for a format fix.

sources.supports: Parameter meanings: depth, child Hessian, L2, row/column sampling; CPU gradient-based sampling added3.2.
Complexity, stochastic sampling, smaller step sizes with more rounds, and sequential HPO to avoid memory contention.
Leaf-wise capacity, minimum leaf support, learning-rate/round interaction and extra_trees.
Bagging requires nonzero bagging_freq and bagging_fraction<1; leaf Hessian versus sample count.
Time-dependent observations require chronology-aware validation rather than ordinary shuffled IID splits.
Reusing scored folds for hyperparameter selection produces optimistic estimates; nested selection separates roles.
